macro_execution.reason: Running the macro (IncrementCounter) fails with 'Microsoft Visual Basic: license information for this component was not found' -- reproduced identically when run from Excel's own Macro dialog (⌥F8) against the UNTOUCHED original fixture, before elixcee ever touched it. This is a Mac Excel/VBA-runtime environment issue on this machine, not an elixcee defect -- ruled out: not a codeName/binding issue (macro is correctly listed and resolvable in the Macro dialog), not specific to external invocation (fails from inside Excel's own UI too), not caused by any file elixcee wrote (fails on the pristine file too). Out of scope for this round; flagged for a fresh environment/session per MACOS_APPLESCRIPT_EXPLORATION.md's own recommendation.

fixtures.has_vba_project_note: Present but unintentional/empty -- carried over from the authoring session's Excel state, not something this fixture set out to test (fixture 2 covers VBA specifically). Not a problem: exercises vbaProject.bin passthrough as a bonus.
fixtures.runs_summary: save-as and in-place: mechanical check clean, no repair warning, edited cell correct. Table/data-validation/conditional-formatting are ALL SILENTLY DROPPED -- see known_gap below.

known_gap.summary: xl/tables/table1.xml survives as a passthrough part (bytes intact), but the worksheet's own <tableParts>/<dataValidations>/<conditionalFormatting> elements are gone -- build_xlsx_sheet fully regenerates xl/worksheets/sheetN.xml from Vm cell state on every save, with no mechanism for any worksheet-embedded XML feature it doesn't itself model (only <cols>/<sheetData>/<mergeCells> are emitted). This is NOT a new bug: the 0.8.0 safe-round-trip milestone's own Non-goals section already named exactly this ('anything embedded in a regenerated xl/worksheets/sheetN.xml does not survive'). Confirmed live: after any elixcee save touching this sheet, real Excel shows 0 list objects, no data validation type on the previously-validated cell, 0 format conditions -- silently, no repair warning. Fixing this is a real feature (selectively re-inject known worksheet-embedded elements, or diff/merge instead of fully regenerating sheetN.xml), matching the scope of a future milestone (ROADMAP.md's planned 'Lossless Worksheet Preservation'), not a quick fix -- explicitly not attempted in this round.

bugs_found_and_fixed_this_round.summary: WorkbookSheet (the struct backing the CLI/PyO3 load path) had no field for formula text at all -- every save silently flattened every untouched formula cell to its last cached value, with no <f> element.

xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels and _rels/.rels are both fully regenerated from a fixed template that only knew about worksheet/sharedStrings/styles/vbaProject/officeDocument -- xl/theme/theme1.xml and docProps/{app,core}.xml passed through byte-identical but lost their relationships, becoming orphaned parts.

workbook.xml's content type was chosen from whether a VBA project was actually present, not from the output file extension -- any .xlsm output with no VBA project (the common case for fixture 1) declared the plain (non-macro) content type inside a .xlsm-named file. This was the dominant cause: Excel refused to open the file outright, not even a repair prompt, until fixed.

known_gaps_confirmed_not_new_bugs.not_affected: None of these ever cause a repair warning -- Excel silently drops the feature, confirmed for every case above.
known_gaps_confirmed_not_new_bugs.recommendation: Real feature work (re-inject known elements into the regenerated worksheet, or move to diff/merge instead of full regeneration), not attempted this round -- matches the scope of a planned future milestone.
